verdict.rationale: Neon has a first-party 'Connection pooling' docs page under /docs/connect, which suggests a managed, built-in pooler. A serverless driver page also exists. Both are bare titles with no content, so the specifics of the story are unevidenced. Missing for 10: evidence that the pooler is built in and managed by Neon (no self-run pgbouncer or proxy), documented concurrency limits supporting thousands of connections, pooling-mode details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
